title: asperula glauca subsp. pruinosa
intro: Asperula glauca subsp. pruinosa, commonly known as Woodruff, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Asperula glauca subsp. pruinosa are attributed to its antiseptic and expectorant properties, which aid in relieving congestion and promoting the removal of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, such as asperuloside and aucubin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
